notes.title: 2 MILLION PLAYERS AND THE BIGGEST UPDATE SO FAR WITH OVER 1,000 IMPROVEMENTS!
notes.content:
Hi Youtubers!

It’s been a month since we announced the #CityStories update, a free update for Youtubers Life 2 that brings new ways of playing the game, exploring NewTube City and experiencing all its hidden adventures! Finally today, we have some big news to celebrate with you!

Youtubers Life franchise reaches
2 MILLION lifetime players!
Matching the first anniversary of Youtubers Life 2, the whole franchise reaches 2 million players who have started their road to fame across all platforms. To celebrate it, now you can update Youtubers Life 2 with more than 1,000 improvements for FREE!

The #CityStories update comes as a celebration for your support during these 12 months Youtubers Life 2 has been released. With over 3,000 streamers playing the game, and more than 50 million views on Youtube achieved during its first year, we couldn’t be happier with how well you have received Youtubers Life 2. Thank you!

Let’s take a look at the new trailer and everything that’s coming to your game right now!

[previewyoutube=8wQJ1SS3CBI;full][/previewyoutube]
Complete challenges and get more stuff from the
New Tubitickets Terminal!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/31dd8e28bcf5a876ef4540fc1709b30f958ec8e6.png

With the new Tubiticket feature, you can complete challenges and redeem points at the Tubiticket Terminal. You’ll obtain different resources, such as special discounts, upgrades to your channels, boost for your friendships and even additional items. You will never run out of stuff to do!

Choose the way you want to grow with the
New Skill Tree!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/6d72e0f9f7e7e5db205c4f1eb30fb4911a904316.png
Produce and publish content to earn skill points, and develop your skills as a Youtuber. You will be able to unlock new scripts for your videos and improve their performance. Master your abilities, improve your workshops and create the most unique content online!

Become whoever you want to be with
New Customization Items and Rewards!!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/f1d2dfb7f09700d45134bb762ef1deb33ea37ae7.jpg

Has your style gone out of fashion? Refresh your identity with new personalization options for your character creations, new clothes and costumes, awesome new furniture collections to decorate your home and interactive items to make your setup alive!

Dash around the city
On your Unicycle!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/0889f98f92128a51a55fd38a7cdb655dd5ad73ff.jpg
Wandering the streets looking for a scooter station is not classy enough for an internet celebrity like you. Hop on your unicycle whenever you want, race through NewTube City and get those trends before they’re gone. Don’t forget to snap some pics on the way!

Grow your network and enjoy
Improved Friendship Stories and Cutscenes!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/49de68ce703b90a8e1cdf5c4485e5e2ba43ecaf9.jpg
It’s time to forge relationships with more than 30 charismatic characters! Become involved in their lives and build meaningful friendships, now with fresher dialogues, new cutscenes and exclusive rewards. 

Create content as never before with
New Card Benefits and Masteries!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/0596a3709e8d941564fbf598fd6098fbc9bb565b.jpg
You will be able to increase your video score by using the newly added card effects, by obtaining temporary buffs while you record your videos. Mix that with the new Mastery feature and showcase your expertise in the different video game genres to get the most views.

Over 1,000 new additional
Improvements and Fixes!

We have been listening to you and gathering your feedback to massively improve on the game experience and fix a huge amount of annoying bugs that have been reported to us. We can’t wait to hear what you think about it! 

Expand the following list to check out some of the most important fixes thanks to your feedback, but remember that there are tons more you can discover in-game right away!
[expand type=details]

 We’ve fixed the bug in which workstations became invisible and blocked the entrance door when players tried to customized them.
 Fixed an issue where upgrades for the gaming corner were blocked and showed prices at 999.999 or “Nombre” as their name.
 Workstation customization now won’t reset once applied.
 The bug which did not allow you to upgrade your workstations has been fixed. Upgrades are not blocked anymore after upgrading your house.
 Character blocks when opening the photo album app, speaking to NPCs or going to sleep have been fixed.
 Fixed an issue where new published videos showed as repetitions of previous ones, as well as several bugs with the video editing workstation.
 Fixed an issue in which the resolution of the game was defaulted to an incorrect aspect ratio.
 Several crashes which resulted in deleted saves under specific conditions have been fixed.
 Issues with the PC components' durability have been fixed.
 Issues with the spawn of NPCs have been fixed.
 Fixed an issue where going to sleep resulted in an infinite loop, forcing the player to restart the game.
 Fixed an issue in which stores didn’t show the correct items available.
 Baba May won’t clip with tables when sitting next to them. She won’t get up from her wheelchair when you speak to her either.
 The scroll in the game menu on your workstation is not missing anymore.
 You can now order on Amazing On when your inventory is full.
 Fixed an issue where the Instalife app camera was placed in the position of the gameplay camera.
 Fixed an issue where performing two different actions at the same time resulted in a softlock.
 Going out during a storm in the Port neighborhood won’t trigger a loud thunder sound.
 Conditions to trigger the #FitDayChallenge trend have been changed, making it much easier to obtain.
 Fixed an issue where the drone’s message was incorrectly shown in the house upgrade menu.
 Fixed an issue where it was possible to clip with subway entrances while on scooter.
 Fixed an issue where the camera position when getting to the Uptown district by subway was incorrect.
 Fixed an issue where NPCs could move the player’s position while the prompt to exercise was on screen, making it impossible to interact with the exercise machines.
 Fixed an issue where options to upgrade your furniture were shown, but couldn’t be obtained.
 Fixed an issue where the characters’ appearance on the ‘Contacts’ app wasn’t updated.
 Fixed an issue where the music from an area didn’t reproduce after a friendship event in said area.
 Sliders on the settings menu now play a sound when selecting a new value.
 Fixed an issue where you were softlocked inside buildings.
 Fixed an issue where you weren’t able to talk to DJ Cerulean during her friendship event.
 Reactions during video recordings are not working.
 Fixed an issue where the golden skin drone bug wasn’t available at the Drone app after having obtained it.
 Fixed an issue where Katzia NT quest couldn't be completed after you had done unboxings of all the items from one of the stores she requested.
 Fixed an issue in which Zane's friendship blocked the game.
 Fixed an issue where you could run out of energy during Inoxtag quest, resulting in a softlock.
 Fixed an issue where Paluten and GermanLetsPlay’s quest crashed and couldn’t be completed.
 Fixed an issue where Dorian's affinity didn’t rise.
 Adam's USB for his first friendship quest can be obtained again after you divorce him and erase his memory.
 The player won’t be locked in Elite Fitness Club after closing time.
 Some texture glitches have been fixed.
 Several issues with texts, localization, and dialogues have been fixed.
 Several issues with the interface have been fixed.
 Several issues with characters’ affinities and gifts have been fixed.
 Several issues during cutscenes have been fixed (incorrect positions, missing dialogues, etc).
 Several issues with character animations have been fixed.
 Many other fixes to improve the gaming experience.

[/expand]

On top of that, here is one more surprise for you:
The brand new official Youtubers Life 2 Characters Guide is now available! 
This additional FREE content includes almost 80 pages of exclusive designs and information about the stories, likes, quests, hobbies, agendas, and much more stuff from over 30 characters in the game. You can download it for FREE through this link or by scanning the QR Code below:

notes.title: DEVS ANSWER YOUR QUESTIONS! THE PRESENT AND FUTURE OF YOUTUBERS LIFE 2
notes.content:
What's up, promising Youtuber!

Last week we were happy to announce the AskTheDev Youtubers Life 2 Edition where you sent us your questions about the development of Youtubers Life 2. Now, the dev team has answered some of the most frequently asked questions!

THANK YOU for participating and sending us all your marvelous questions! We have gathered all of them we have received through Discord, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, and Steam, to give you answers to the most common topics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40308403/ce31372a1ee9657d769b8fcde0cdb3112baf1782.jpg

@savanahwaddles on Instagram and Dragonknight8129#5696 on Discord ask...
Why did you decide to make Youtubers Life 2?

"After releasing Youtubers Life 1, we noticed there were a lot of players enjoying this experience, and asking for more mechanics and options for the game. After going through a long development, you know, that's quite heartening! 

For a few years, we were adding new content according to the community's feedback, but there was a point when we wanted to implement new ideas that required a different game basis. Many players asked for more social features, which led us to build a city with peculiar characters to interact with. These technical changes required starting a new project, which has been also used to offer a different experience from the first title, thus incorporating new concepts such as customization, friendships, socials, channels, or trends.

We love the first title! Youtubers Life 1 has brought great concepts to how we create games, and after 5 years, we are still learning from all the experiences gathered together with the community.

Nice question! Thanks for asking!"



CQuade comments on Steam...
How did you come up with the characters in Youtubers Life 2?

"Creating a character, their personalities, and personal stories, was one of the most fun things during the development! We are not just fans of everything related to Youtubers, but also big lovers of films, comics, series, and fantasy! We wanted to create characters with strong personalities and unique stories and designs, inspired by those well-known references that many Youtubers may recognize.

That's why you may identify some characters just like Gigi who was inspired by the malicious Cruella de Vil from 101 Dalmatians, or you may recall Zane as the king of Atlantis, Aquaman! We also created Dorian inspired by Klauss, from The Umbrella Academy, 'cause we love that character! Also, Arrou may have some similarities with Green Arrow, 'cause we also include wanted to include superhero inspirations. 

You may even recognize the friendship story of Babamey from that old-school romance on a ship, Titanic, even if she didn't remember it yet, 'cause you know... it's been 84 years! Playing their missions can be just as much fun as it was for us to develop them... you may find some fascinating Easter eggs from different dimensions!

And not only the characters and their stories, but also many items around the city show that kind of inspiration to immerse you in the experience! Have you seen that peculiar board game from Geektopia? It may ring a bell if you saw Jumanji! Did you see that the function of the Er-Brainlyzer is inspired by the Men in Black's memory eraser? 

There are so many references around you, and we would never end if we tell you all of them! We hope you enjoy them and make your way as an emerging Youtuber even more fun!"



mrkruppy13#2778 says on Discord...
In Youtubers Life 1, Mom is in the game. In the 2nd game, she is gone! What happened?

"Youtubers Life 2 continues the path of Youtubers Life 1, where you have proven to be the most promising Youtuber, so Xavier invites you to NewTube City to reach new goals. Now you must make more decisions to decide how to develop your career, what trends to follow, which characters you want to interact with, where and how to create your content, or how to make the most of your time.

By the concept of moving to NewTube City, you start a new free independent life to reach new goals as a Youtuber, thus raising new levels of your career and focusing on how you want to develop and grow your channel, without worrying about studies or housework.

But don't worry! Moms are moms, and they are always with you, no matter what. She stays at her home, and is so happy that you managed to get there! And who knows... we may know more about her in a feasible future."



@unanonimo444 on Instagram and doge#5268 on Discord say...
Why did they change the gameplay so much compared to Youtubers Life 1? Is there a connection between the first and the second game?

"We launched Youtubers Life 1 5 years ago, and the idea of becoming a Youtuber has been evolving and growing until now. And you know, we didn't want to just make the same game but better, but rather incorporate new concepts to offer an up-to-date point of view on being a Youtuber. New social channels have appeared, and other channels have also become more relevant for every influencer, so we had to study carefully what was new, what changed, and what we should focus on.

Youtubers Life 1 offers a Tycoon and Strategic approach to being an influencer, where everything is more focused as a straight line. On the other hand, Youtubers Life 2 presents a broader world, with more freedom and where you decide how to use your time to explore and grow your channel.

Nowadays, trends are constantly changing, so the best way to get more likes and gain followers stands by this concept. You know, there is no magic formula to succeed, so all prior research may help you decide what you want to do next, and that's quite the challenge about being a Youtuber.

So, we developed Youtubers Life 2 to offer a new experience, learning from the first title and including new perspectives of what a Youtuber is meant to be. We hope that you enjoy it!"



@buzzbuz7 asks on Twitter...
Why can’t we change our avatar's appearance again?

"There are different options in Youtubers Life 2 to customize your avatar. Some of them might be by the naked eye, but you may need to search a little more and even increase your relationship with special characters to get advanced options and customizations. 

It is true that once you create your character and select your body type and skin color, you cannot change them after that, But that's what creating your own special Youtuber avatar is all about, right? We are convinced that customizing your own avatar in extremely crazy ways, can be much more fun and unique for every Youtuber. Otherwise, your fans won't recognize you!

You can easily change your clothes, including masks, dresses, cosplays, headphones, glasses, piercings, and more in your Dressing Room through your mobile app or by accessing your wardrobe at your home. You can spend some coins to buy new outfits in different places like Kiwi Clothes Store, Gianni Clothes Boutique, or Slater Surf, or even get new sets through side missions. 

If you want to give your avatar a completely new fresh look, you may need to visit the Lafayette Hair Salon. His hairdressing is amazing, and you didn't recognize yourself in the mirror! You can also access the shop at the desk to buy new options, including also beards, piercings, and even tattoos.

But that's not all! Did you see the secret door at Lafayette's? If you build a good friendship with him, he may allow you access there, thus adding physical customization options such as facial features, or even eyes or mouth enhancements, just in case you were interested in a cool facial lifting.

We hope that all these options allow you to customize your avatar in so many ways, so you can surprise your followers and even introduce new styles! We really love to see players sharing their avatars on social media and see how creative they are."



EpicTimes asks on Steam...
What gave you the idea to make the plotline of Suzy's cheating and Gigi Maccarone's criminal activity? Thanks so much for making this game! It's so great!

"We are so happy that you are enjoying the game! Youtubers Life 2 has several references from films, literature, and comics, which will help make your daily life more fun in NewTube City.

Gigi Maccarone is a character inspired by Cruella de Vil, thus making her the perfect option to bring organized crime back to NewTube City. Since the gaming industry is one of the most important things in the city, manipulating gaming tournaments for her personal profit was a clear idea. 

On the other hand, we have Suzy, the Spicy Ren Chinese restaurant's old chief who is not very familiar with video games yet. Suzy is quite similar to Gigi, since both are very persistent and they won't stop until reaching their goals. In a world ruled by young people, Suzy also wants to have her personal spot and be part of it. Her story brings the vision that it is never too late to learn something new, nor too old to pursue new dreams, thus highlighting the importance of taking care of ourselves."



Agent J#3581 mentions on Discord...
How long was development for Youtubers life 2 and how did you come up with the characters
"The development of Youtubers Life 2 was nearly 2 years of work. Not only the development itself, but the analysis of what things had changed nowadays in the world of Youtubers, and how we could improve and make the experience of becoming a Youtuber even more fun. 

Each superstar has a unique personality and is surrounded by incredible stories that they always bring to their channel to engage their fans, and that's how that extreme stuff is born and they become more and more trending! We wanted to give players that same feeling, that everything could happen in NewTube City, and we merged our passion for literature, comics, and films with it to create a city full of unique stories and a wide variety of different personalities, thus giving players more options to create unique content, and anecdotes that will motivate them to record for their next video on the channel."



MakingBaconPancakes#0781 and TheOfficialTakeASoda#7701 on Discord, and @anthony.h17 on Instagram ask...
Are you planning on expanding the game more? What do you think will be the future of YouTubers Life 2? Any huge updates that are yet to be announced?

While developing YL2, we did it with one goal in mind: that players could feel the experience of becoming real Youtubers in a city created to meet their dreams. Now that we have just launched the game, we are focused on analyzing all the feedback that we've received, thus working on some updates to improve the final experience even more. 

The idea of ​​being a Youtuber evolves over time, and that's also what would like to represent in Youtubers Life 2, so we keep working on it and studying the community's feedback to know what else we could include to boost that goal. 

Although it is still too soon to specify what new content we could include in the future, what we can say now is that Youtubers Life 2 has a long road ahead, and we are working on a roadmap of contents focused on improving your experience as a true Youtuber. Stay tuned to our social channels to know more!"



NickMck07#7124 on Discord, @d0ne39 on Twitter, and @veryimportantpitties on Instagram comment..
Do you have plans to make YouTuber’s life 3? It’d be a big plan, but also do you have any plans for your company in general?

"You are right, that'd definitely be a big plan! Although we have developed several video games, Youtubers Life 2 is the one that we are more focused on right now. That means that our current goal is to make Youtubers Life 2 the best experience possible for our players.

We have lots of plans for Youtubers Life franchise, but none of them has been fully landed yet. Right now we want to focus on improving Youtubers Life 2, while we keep working on the future of the Franchise.

Then, what would you like to see in the future for the Youtubers Life franchise?"



Broskimate#5803 asks on Discord...
Are there any plans in the future for YL2 on Android and iOS? And keep up the amazing work you guys have been putting out🙂

"This is one of the most frequently asked questions, and we couldn't help but come up with a more detailed answer for you! 

As you probably know, the first title in the franchise was released on all platforms, including mobile, some time after its PC release. This usually happens because other platforms require different development processes, additional time, and careful considerations of whether the game would fit on that platform.

Launching Youtubers Life 2 on mobile is something that we'd love to do too, but there are several factors we are still studying internally to see how we could adapt the game to its mobile version. Right now, all our efforts are focused on improving the Youtubers Life 2 experience for all our players on PC and Consoles, and we hope we can also bring this great experience to our mobile players in the future."


Thank you everyone for your amazing questions! 

Did you enjoy the #AskTheDevYL2? Let us know if you would like us to run another one in the future! And don't forget to follow us on social media and join our Discord Server to stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/24759264/ce6ade2e250b694c22e392bfc715cd74922ef616.jpg

What’s up, u-tubers! 

It has been a long way since Youtubers Life came to your lives, but this journey is far from over. We are so happy to announce a new addition to Youtubers Life: the new Fashion channel! It will be available as a free DLC on November 7. 

As you may already have guessed, everything will be about fashion, tailoring and even hitting the runway! You will start as the best friend of KimK, the biggest influencer when it comes to fashion, and you’ll have to climb your way to the top of the influencer’s list in order to get her crown and become the next big fashionista. It won’t be easy! But we assure you it will be a lot of fun. 

How, you may ask? Well, here are a few things you will be able to do on this new channel.

Tailor every aspect of your life
From off the rack outfits to haute couture. Create your own style based on different themes, colors and seasons... But everybody knows there’s nothing like wearing a tailored shirt, right? You will have control over your clothes, your makeup, and even your haircuts. 

From recording videos to exclusive events
Obviously, recording your own videos and feeding your channel with fashion content will be the main feature of your new adventure. While you start getting more fans and subscribers, you will get noticed by the very brands that are in vogue in the fashion industry.

Get along with them and you will gain access to selected events closed for ordinary people… But you won’t be ordinary at all, so get your camera and your best look and get ready to sip a drink along with the biggest celebrities: if you are lucky enough, you will be able to interview them for your channel!

Hit the runway as the next top model
This new game mode will expand the Fashion channel into uncharted territory as you will become the center of the stage… not on your channel but on the runway. In this new mode, you will have to gather all your expertise to pick the best ensembles available and get ready to bring them to the runway and become the Main Event! Aren’t you excited?

We hope you are as excited as we are with this new content that we believe will expand the possibilities of what you can do on the game. And, as always, we’d love to hear your feedback and ideas concerning the new Fashion channel. Don’t forget to do it on the Steam forums!

Happy U-tubing!

The U-Play Online and Raiser Games Teams.

notes.title: Youtubers Life 1.4 update is here!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/704d4e0960b0c77f185ced4cfebe1e70741947cc.png

Dear players,

First of all, many thanks to everyone who took part in the 1.4 open beta test, your reports were critical to this build's success.

This is a much-improved version over 1.3. Hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed developing it!

Here are the details:

Story
The ticket cost for the first trade fair in the Gaming Channel has been reduced.
The waiting times for several events have been reduced.
The first four houses moving requisites have been changed.


Economy
Videos earn more money from the shared flat onwards.
PC components' price has been reduced between 5% and 45%.
Cosmetic items' price has been reduced between 25% and 40%.
The Cooking Channel utensil price has been adjusted to make them more accessible.
Sleep and hunger expense when working has been reduced.
Food has been rebalanced to improve its cost/reward ratio.
Working now pays better.

Card game
Cards are now obtained through charisma points, a new currency which is earned through courses and missions.
Card unlock levels have been revised.
Card situational bonus has been re-balanced.

Pipper (social network)
Writing a Pipp now takes half as long.
Pipp effect has been increased by 25%.

Gaming Channel
Video games and console releases have been modified to follow a regular schedule.

Other
PC durability has been greatly increased.
Music and Cooking skill ceiling have been increased depending on the house to reduce impact on gameplay.

Gameplay improvements
Collaborators' status doesn't show over your character's bars. It made everything very confusing, leading players to believe that sleep and hunger were bugged.
Mom's house gameplay experience has been improved adding new objectives.
U-Tube videos are now monetized from 500 subs onwards.
The test is now a monthly mission while at mom's house. If you fail three times, it's game over.
The comment moderation has been improved and now displays your discoveries in real time.
The whole collaborator system has been redesigned to add new management features. There's now a new hiring process and there's a motivation variable that will influence their performance through the gameplay.
A new currency has been introduced: Charisma points. They can be used to unlock cards and obtained through missions and courses.
Mission panel has been improved. New weekly missions and clearer rewards. New visual feedback to differentiate missions.
You can now find more assignments at events, given by NPCs, that will let you earn good money.
Notifications have been improved and de-cluttered.
Computers can now be used while they're uploading a video.
There's a new window detailing gamepad and keyboard/mouse keys.

Locations
Gaming trade shows and cinema hall have been redesigned.
Lightning has been improved all around.

Fixed issues

Just for your info, we've treated about [strike]500[/strike] (700 now!) issues since we released 1.3 until today. Some of the most important are:
Finally, we got a historic one: sometimes Network events stopped coming. FIXED!
Phone presentation sometimes failed.
Game froze on loading screen.
Course window blocked progress when a collaborator was selected.
Social bar dropped to 0 sometimes.
GUI translation errors (Spanish text).
Multiple errors in the Pipper section.
Creating live shows and restaurant gigs blocked the game sometimes.
Several card game issues.


Oh... and here's a teaser for what's in the making. Stay tuned for more news!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/9aca1c65b40cfb1c3bc195d8725bb90fe00ed1d0.jpg

Enjoy!
The U-Play Online Team

EDIT: We're working on a new Chinese translation, as well as Polish and Turkish. We still can't say when they'll be available, though.

notes.title: Youtubers Life Update & More - End of 2018
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/1d75923d0dcd38c2a6143037e9a2b9af0dc2ad12.png
Dear Youtubers,

Hello! Long time no see.

After a much-needed break from developing Youtubers Life, we are getting ready to show some love to our beloved offspring again.

We understand it’s very difficult to accurately convey this feeling, but had we kept working on this project, it would’ve been impossible to give our best. Now, we believe it ’s time to give all our fans what you deserve.

Youtubers Life is being deeply reworked. The Game Design and Programming teams are working together to shape and polish your favourite features, improve the ones that troubled you the most and even remove tedious tasks. We’ve been gathering constructive feedback from your comments, reviews and Steam Community Posts, and this is the blueprint for the elements that will be added and/or reworked:
GUI will be revamped. Lots of cosmetic and functional improvements
New redesigned fancy cards, and new mechanics for the cards game
Improved deeper subs morale system that adds social network interactions and public presence in events to the formula
New social network interaction, deeper and more realistic social network to communicate with your followers
NPC Quest givers, now you can get new missions and assignments in events while interacting with people
Network system rework: new assignment market, improved network events and changes in requirements
Game re-balance, moving houses objectives will be changed
New video comments system, now you can spend some time answering the comments in your videos and getting some clues about what your followers like most
Besides mouse control you will be able to play the game with gamepad controls, so you can play it while laying on the couch
Commission video assignments to collaborators, a convenient mini-feature to speed up workflow
We’ve added a new quest log screen to get more info about it
General usability improvements
Some examples of our work in progress:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/39db93f80dc93053467840576d65a31df1f8e1a7.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/633c5ffeb249c0fe20ded7793c73bd2878818135.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/f53812841edd6f6e5c4119ff708470064d0613cf.jpg

These are the main features on the table, but it’s still an alive project and there might be more changes added on the fly if we feel that it’s needed.  We’ll keep you updated on what’s going on.

When?
Now, on dates: you know we’re an indie studio so speed is not on our side. We know you’ve shown infinite patience, but in order to do this the right way, we can’t rush it! Expect this update by end of 2018, but never before it’s ready and we’re completely satisfied with what we’ve got.

But there is more…

There’s a new channel coming!
The three existing channels will get a new addition. More info on the all-new fourth channel very soon, as we’re currently shaping its design. The new channel follows a different schedule and it will be released after the update is out and stable.

Price?
We said update! This will definitely be free content for all the owners of Youtubers Life

Remember to join our Community Hub to discuss this update and what you expect or wish to see on it: https://steamcommunity.com/app/428690/discussions/


A big thank you,

The U-Play Online Team

notes.title: Youtubers Life future development and roadmap
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/24759264/06d678a91897edb7db42dd94afa822292c9fcffe.png

Dear players,

Yesterday we launched Youtubers Life, a game which had been in Early Access since last May the 18th. First of all, thanks again to all our Early Access supporters, this has been a dream come true and we couldn’t have done this without you.
Thank you too for the wonderful reception and the congratulations, they mean the world to us. We read all the reviews and comments, positive and negative, and we feel that we need to further explain some key points and our future development roadmap

Why did we get Youtubers Life out of Early Access?
Getting out of EA for us means that we’re happy with the state of the game as it is right now. Since it’s EA launch, we’ve gotten Youtubers Life to levels of stability and game maturity that we feel are worth calling Youtubers Life a full game.
Fully releasing the game also has other implications. It increases diffusion: there are many media outlets that don’t review Early Access games, for example, and lots of people are not keen on purchasing EA titles.

Other platforms
We’ve always wanted to release Youtubers Life on every available platform. Steam has been a phenomenal springboard and, if you’ve stuck around the forums during this last 9 months, we’ve always relied on community input to improve the game, having a constant two-way communication with our player base. Look at the last update [0.9.3], for example, the most popular requests condensed in a User Experience improvement that’s brought new life to the game.
The console versions are past due time, they deserve to enjoy Youtubers Life too, but we needed the stability of a full release-worthy game in order to commit to finish development for consoles and other platforms.

Further development
Coming out of Early Access doesn’t mean we’ve stopped developing Youtubers Life. In fact, console development will bring controller support and any new feature we implement to the Steam version too.
The core game is cross-platform. This means that we’ll continue improving the game as we work on other versions too.
More content will come your way, although not in the short term. Our will is to develop the initially thought channels as free DLCs, and we’ve got other exciting ideas for the future too.
We’d like you to see Youtubers Life Full Release launch as a kid that just turned 18: it’s reached maturity, but its real life has just begun. The best is yet to come!

The impact of the Music and Cooking Channels
The decision to postpone new channel development for the moment being relies on several factors

The launch of the new channels didn’t improve the user experience as much as we’d hoped. Studying player statistics we can see that more than half of the new games that start everyday belong to the gaming channel.
We want to take our time to bring an exciting new channel that will be meaningful enough, and powerful as a standalone and significant slice of Youtubers Life. We’d never satisfied releasing sub-par content.


TL;DR
We understand that every decision comes with its pros and cons, but we’re really happy with what we’ve accomplished with Youtubers Life and what will come in the future. This game’s roadmap is very alive and its development will go on. The Full Release is just another milestone for us!
We won’t fail the community, we’re devoted to making the best tycoon we’re capable of. We’re not Arrou after all!

Sincerely,

The U-Play Online Team

PS: As always, you’re very welcome to come visit the discussion forum:
[code]http://steamcommunity.com/app/428690/discussions/[/code]

The core game is cross-platform. This means that we’ll continue improving the game as we work on other versions too.
More content will come your way, although not in the short term. Our will is to develop the initially thought channels as free DLCs, and we’ve got other exciting ideas for the future too.

notes.title: Version 0.7.15 Update published
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Finally! 0.7.15 is released into the wild!
We know it's taken a long time since we first published the beta, but there were a lot of changes and optimization going on and we found trouble. Now, with this last update, everything seems to have clicked into place and we feel the game is much more polished now.

A big, big thank you goes to all our players that have participated in our beta program and have helped us through reporting. Please, remember to opt out of both private and public betas until a new one is released, just to be safe.

We can finally set all our efforts on finishing the music channel and releasing it as soon as possible. We're still aiming for late September / early October.
Keep tuned to our news section, Twitter and Facebook for announcements!

As a reminder, bug reporting for the live version should be placed in the following forum:

[code]http://steamcommunity.com/app/428690/discussions/7/[/code]

Finally fixed the bug where some assignments didn't get marked as done! Now they all work correctly.
Collaborators don't get stuck on dancing anymore.
The 100k subs award event loads correctly now.

Collaborators showed <100 skill level before hiring, then dropped to sub 100.
There were some instances where the game calculator gave an error .number and the sub count and money took ridiculous values, should be fixed now.
Some achievements did not get properly registered.
Consoles don't stack on top of each other anymore. Better distribution.


New feature!
Companies:

Our awesome game design team came up with this idea much like a faction system. Just like in real life, once your U-Tube channel becomes relevant, companies will start seeking your partnership to promote their products or services.

Other changes:

New languages available: Ukranian and Turkish.
When a new game is started, you'll have one friend instead of several.
Phones are now found in the tech store.
Some beverages (coffee & energy drinks) will now give you some energy while replenishing your hunger bar, so you can postpone sleeping for later.
We've improved the mansion (pre-space) layout. Now it's a one story building.
Some redundant and superfluous notifications have been removed.


We hope you continue enjoying our game as much as we enjoy working on it!

Have a nice day.

Kind regards,
The U-Play Online team

notes.title: Version 0.7.12 Update published
notes.content:
Dear players,

The new update is finally here!
After several hard-working weeks and countless hours scratching our heads, we have a new release available for you.
Special thanks to the generous players that helped with the beta test during the last two days, you're a key part for Youtubers Life development and we're proud to have such a generous community ːsteamhappyː

What we've worked on:

New available languages: Czech, simplified Chinese, Portuguese and Vietnamese. Special thanks to all the volunteers who made this possible. We send lots of love your way!
Steam achievements. The achievements will be activated when they're triggered. For example, you'll need to start a new game to get the low level achievements.
Steam trading cards.
Steam cloud save. Now, your progress is saved in Steam and linked to your account, allowing you to play on more than one computer!
GUI changes and optimization. We're constantly working on improving the user interface.
Improved collaborator behaviour. Also, bugs concerning collaborators have been squashed.
Changes in the networks to improve the user experience.
In-game U-Play Online subscriber awards to decorate your room.
Passive talents are now displayed too.
Lots of miscellaneous bugs that'd make this a kilometric list.


Regarding new channels:

We read everything! either in the forums, the news section comments, the reviews... everything.
We know you're eager to receive new content, and we'd really like to be able to do it right now. Here! have all the career paths!.
But, as you know, this is an early access game and we're a small studio, our resources are limited. I can promise we're working as hard as possible to bring new content to you, but it takes time.
Developing new channels is almost like developing a new game, and now we're split between new channels and general game stability, trying to optimize our resources and making the best game possible while we advance in content.
That being said, don't expect the music career path (yes, it'll be the next released channel) at least until late September. We know it seems like a lot of time, but weeks go by so fast when you're immersed in game development that giving you an earlier date would be unrealistic.
We want to make a good game, because we care about our players, hence we'll never release subpar content.
You have our word, the new channels will be worth the wait ːsteamhappyː

Happy youtubing!

Lots of love,

The Team

notes.title: Version 0.7.10 Update Published (new cards system)
notes.content:
Today we want to present you the first update to include new content to the game. We have reworked all the cards system to fix gameplay problems giving you the chance of making the game a little more challenging and fun to play in the long term. It still needs some polish and better explanation, but this was a step we need to be able to integrate new channel types in the game.

The new cards game has three big changes: 

- You have to choose between 3 cards when you are awarded with a new one. Now, when you see a warning number in the cards button, 3 cards will be shown and you will have to pick one. 

- Deck building. In the cards collection screen you can now choose what cards to use and discard the cards that you don't want. The bulb-cost of your videos is more balanced too. Be sure to check your deck after you're awarded a new card.

- Guess the right card. Now everytime you record a video, you must match it with an emotion from your cards, and you might be right or wrong. You will need to figure out which emotion fits best with each recording situation. 

This is a big change in gameplay and we hope that you like it but you will need some time to get used to it. Our advice is that you start a new game to fully understand these new features. 

Apart from this, we have made a lot of new changes including the following: 

- NEW: Italian and Polish translations have been included officially in the game. Thanks Riccardo Ruspoli, KivanAumar, El Brio, and Golden Pen Team	F. || FromSilverToGlobal & Hirek
- NEW: gorgeous new clothes for girls 
- NEW: different customization options 
- NEW: addition of new effects and emojis for personal relationships 
- NEW: interest is shown in a different way 
- NEW: other UI changes 

- FIX: crash at start
- FIX: courses do not end 
- FIX: problems collaborating in videos
- FIX: fixed problem upgrading computer to an inferior version 
- FIX: removed Replace PC option 
- FIX: problems in the 2-floor apartment with the second PC —you probably have to wait 2 weeks until the option of a new PC shows up. 
- FIX: performance optimization 
- FIX: other minor bugs 

We hope you enjoy this update.

Thanks

notes.title: Version 0.7.4 Update published
notes.content:
In these quick updates we are exclusively focusing ourselves in improving the stability of the game. We are mainly fixing the crashes which are affecting some of the players.

In particular, there are three specially serious situations on which we are working with the precious help of some of you. We apologize ourselves if some of these errors are sitll unsolved, we will improve bit by bit:

- Crash when starting the game: we have no information which can help us solve this. Every little information provided will be very helpful.
- Crash after customizing your character: this error is happening in systems with Windows 32 bits. We have tried different configurations in old systems —16GB RAM included— and the game works properly except in Windows 32 bits. We have cornered this error and we will probably find a solution next week. Meanwhile, we advice you to update the OS if you have the chance of doing so.
- Corrupted files: these crases may cause corrupted game files and the impossibility of uploading new files. This error is already solved in the current version.

Apart from that, as follows you will find the list of new changes:

- Crash in the talent screen fixed
- Crash in the stores fixed
- Bugs related to the colour of the hair in the character customization screen fixed
- Bug when the console is won in the event fixed
- Minor bugs fixed

We will not be publishing any new update during the weekend. However, we will try to reply to your questions as we have done so far.

Thank you for your patience.

Have a great weekend!
